firstNightReminder: The Buffet's Gourmet chooses a character type. :reminder: Show five not-in-play character tokens of that type.
otherNightReminder: The Buffet's Gourmet chooses a different character type. :reminder: Show five not-in-play character tokens of that type.
name: Buffet's Gourmet Ω
ability: On your 1st four nights, choose a different character type: you learn five not-in-play characters for it.
flavor: Oh no, those flavours couldn't possibly go together. Pass.

name: Hero Ω
ability: The 2nd good player executed doesn't die & can't die tonight.
flavor: A hero always arrives just in the nick of ti... Oh wait one died already.

firstNightReminder: The Suitor chooses a character. Give a thumb signal. :reminder:
otherNightReminder: The Suitor chooses a character. If it's not in play, give a thumbs down signal. If it's in play and the 1st time, give a thumbs up signal. :reminder: Otherwise, give a thumbs down signal. :reminder:
name: Suitor Ω
ability: Each night, choose a character: learn if it is in play. The 2nd time you would learn a yes, you learn no, & stop waking.
flavor: THIS IS THE HAPPIEST DAY OF MY LIFE!

name: Racketeer Ω
ability: Each night, learn how many Outsiders are alive. Your 2 non-Traveller neighbors might register as evil & Outsiders.

name: Dullahan Ω
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. You & 1 good neighbor may register as an opposite-aligned character to Townsfolk abilities.
flavor: It is too late now. Death is coming and they are blind. You may know everything, but they will never believe you.

firstNightReminder: Wake the Sin of Gluttony. :reminder: They choose 3 players. :reminder: :reminder: :reminder:
otherNightReminder: If the Sin of Gluttony did not wake last night, wake the Sin of Gluttony. :reminder: They choose 3 players. :reminder: :reminder: :reminder:
name: Sin of Gluttony Ω
ability: Each other night, choose three players: the first two will die at any time within the next two nights, the third might die at any time during the next two days.
flavor: You all look so tasty, it would be a shame to let you go to waste...
